avis.titre: Nice toner, but petals are bothersome
avis.texte: I'm generally a fan of Kiehl's products and tried this toner for the first time about 6 months ago. I found it soothing and hydrating. I had no issues with it irritating my skin, feeling drying, etc. The scent is light and has a nearly undetectable earthy floral aroma. Overall I enjoyed using it and my combination skin seemed to like it, though it didn't really wow me. My two complaints about this product that will ultimately keep me from repurchasing are the price and the calendula petals that are left in the toner. I personally feel the price is too high for what the product is; unfortunately Kiehl's continues to raise prices. As far as the petals go, I feel like they're left in to make the product appear more 'natural' but are just annoying during application. The bottle is not designed to keep them from coming out, so as pictured I would dispense the toner onto a cotton pad and end up with petals all over. They do not disintegrate during application, so they just ended up stuck to my face. I found the sensory experience of having to pick them off my face every time I used the toner to be unpleasant.
